details:
as to

https://feedback.vrchat.com/avatar-30/p/feedback-parameter-driver-over-time

i was thinking of extra options aswell.

Delay:

Chooses the delay in an animation from 0 to 100% when a driver will start.

(as to post link above:)

Smoothing:

Chooses two numbers and blends them together over the course of the animation clip.

Additive Loop:

Choose a number which adds constantly every frame until the clip ends, a state exit, or a set end value has been met (ex: end looping additive at 0.15 float value)

Additive loop part 2 (Delay):

just sets a delay between each additive during the clip, default is 0.1

the Additive Loop and Smoothing will prevent having to use an entire other layer for transitioning values smoothly

Smoothing and Additive Loop are different types, for the exact same situation you'd prefer Add instead of Set

Delay will allow less complicated delay systems for parameter driver updating
title: Extra Parameter Driver Options
